snippet.title: Wastelanders // Trailer
snippet.description:
Play the Game ► https://store.steampowered.com/app/3830470/Wastelanders/

A dystopian turn-based strategy game where you make moves with crafty combat cards. Assemble your deck, exploit Clashes to turn the tides in your favour, and survive long enough to learn the secrets of the Wasteland.

Developed by 
Studio Lilac
